articles.summary: WEST DES MOINES, Iowa, Jan. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - West Bancorporation, Inc. (Nasdaq: WTBA; the “Company”), parent company of West Bank, today reported 2025 net income of $32.6 million, or $1.92 per diluted common share, compared to 2024 net income of $24.1 million, or $1.42 per diluted common share.
